hook.say: Lunch near Senso-ji for under one thousand yen? Yes.

beats.say: Bazoku. Hand-pulled noodles like tantanmen, under one thousand yen. Open every day.
Enshuya, by Tawaramachi. A grilled or simmered fish set for eight hundred eighty yen. Weekday and Saturday lunch only.
Then Mangando for imo-kin, a sweet potato cake. Open every day.
